title: MoveClassTable
description: Which moves of the format fall in each move class of the move-use diagnostic (#1164), read from the pinned engine's move data for the format's mod and bound to the engine-data table by hash. A class is a rule over the engine's own fields, never a list written by hand: status is the Status category; lowers_target_stat is a move whose data always lowers a stat stage of its target (a boosts table with a negative stage on a move aimed at a foe, or a secondary with chance 100 that does); raises_own_stat is a move whose data always raises a stat stage of the user or an ally (boosts on a self or ally target, or a self boost with chance 100); side_condition is a move that sets a side condition; field_condition sets a weather, a terrain or a pseudo-weather; protection is the engine's stallingMove (the Protect family and Endure). A move may be in several classes. Effects an engine callback produces (onHit and the like) and secondaries with a chance below 100 are not read. Each list is sorted and unique and holds ids of the engine-data table; the reader enforces that and that the status list is exactly the Status moves. Its RFC 8785 SHA-256 is the move-class table hash. Derived from the pinned Showdown data files (MIT licence, see fixtures/showdown/<format>/NOTICE-engine-data.txt).
